page.layout: One column of index entries, with page references set to the right of each entry, under the running head at the top. The right edge is cut off.; One column of alphabetical index entries, with page numbers after some entries; the right edge of the column is cut off. Heading "E X." at top left.; One column of reference numbers, right-aligned, running the full height of the page; fragments of headwords at the left edge; catchword "formido" alone at the lower right.
page.notes: Running head "I N D" is the spaced-out index title, partly legible. Several page numbers are small or smudged and are marked [?]: "finalirer", "fingere 381", and "fluctus 115.771". The entry "finalirer" is probably "finaliter". The headword "findere, findi" and the entries "finis" and "firmare, firmari" have their final references set on a separate line in the scan; they are joined here. Right-hand ends of several lines are cut off by the scan edge; only the visible letters and figures are given, e.g. "fluxus 127.1", "fœmina, fœm", "fœnum cordu". The first letter of "fluce" and "Fluinen" is doubtful in the scan. Doubtful: the leading digits of the lines "7. 182. 451. 458.", "70.182.197.293." and "644.719.856.858." are partly cut at the left edge; "644.719.856.858." may read 836 rather than 856. The left-edge word fragments "inæ" and "m" are incomplete. "13" at the start of its line is uncertain.
